POWER MECHANICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #2
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Braking system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Braking system.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Braking system.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Braking system.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Braking system.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. CPU
   C. Monitor
   D. Keyboard

3. When learning Isometric projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Isometric projection.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Isometric projection.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Isometric projection.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Isometric projection.

4. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   B. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   C. Ignore burnt cables
   D. Overload every socket

5. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

6. When learning Suspension system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Suspension system.

8. When learning Metalwork processes in power mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Metalwork processes in power mechanics.

9. When learning Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Health and safety in a power mechanics work environment.

10. When learning Limits, fits and tolerance, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Limits, fits and tolerance.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Limits, fits and tolerance.

11. When learning Principles of Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Principles of Power Mechanics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Principles of Power Mechanics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Principles of Power Mechanics.

12. When learning Steering system, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Steering system.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Steering system.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Steering system.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Steering system.

13. When learning ISO Thread forms, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

14. When learning Project, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

15. When learning Orthographic projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Orthographic projection.

16. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool
